## 🧠 A model for each job

Choose separate models for schedules and work Nod starts on its own in **Settings → Models**. Keep your main model for chat, use **The light model** for routine checks, or select another connected text model. Individual tasks and schedules can have their own model too.

Try telling Nod: “Run my schedules on the light model.” Model choices show estimated costs when pricing is available. Changes apply from the next turn. [Choose your models](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/connect/models/#models-for-each-kind-of-work).

## 🧵 Know which task is asking

Questions from tasks and schedules now show the name of the work above them. A pink dot marks a question that needs you. After you answer, the line shows progress as the work continues. Select a task’s line to open its card.

## Also in this release

- **Stay awake:** The desktop app prevents idle sleep while local work runs. Closing the lid or choosing Sleep still puts your computer to sleep.
- **Local files:** Paths starting with `~` work. Ask to see a file and Nod attaches it in chat.
- **Model connections:** Better handling of OpenAI-compatible servers, incomplete model details, and failed connections. Errors keep the service’s reason.
- **Schedules:** Updates keep the instructions you gave when you created the schedule.
- **First steps:** Say hello or ask for ideas. Nod offers a small task and a clear result to get you started.
